description: Quick capture schemas — minimum input for maximum diagnostic gain. Each test distilled to its essential diagnostic signal with screening context awareness.

side.description: Auto-fills side_tested from screening region selection

region.description: Filters ROM joints, neuro levels, and region-specific options

pain_location.description: Screening already captured where it hurts — absorbs pain_location fields from quick capture

symptoms.description: Screening captured symptom quality — absorbs symptom_quality/reproduced fields

vas_score.description: Pain intensity already known — absorbs pain_intensity/pain_during_test fields

ASSESS_001.name: Lachman Test
ASSESS_001.diagnostic_value: ACL integrity — grade indicates laxity severity

ASSESS_002.name: McMurray Test

key_metric.label: Location
key_metric.diagnostic_reason: Medial vs lateral differentiates which meniscus

ASSESS_002.diagnostic_value: Meniscal tear — medial vs lateral meniscus

ASSESS_004.name: Pivot Shift Test
ASSESS_004.diagnostic_value: ACL rotational instability — most specific ACL test

ASSESS_005.name: Empty Can Test (Jobe's)
ASSESS_005.diagnostic_value: Supraspinatus — pain only = tendinopathy, weakness = tear

ASSESS_006.name: Hawkins-Kennedy Test
ASSESS_006.diagnostic_value: Subacromial impingement — high sensitivity screening test

key_metric.label: Pain angle
key_metric.diagnostic_reason: Earlier onset (<90°) suggests more significant impingement

ASSESS_008.name: Drop Arm Test
ASSESS_008.diagnostic_value: Full-thickness rotator cuff tear — high specificity

ASSESS_010.name: Straight Leg Raise (SLR)

key_metric.label: Angle
key_metric.diagnostic_reason: <30° = large disc herniation, 30-60° = nerve root tension, >60° = less specific

ASSESS_010.diagnostic_value: Lumbar disc herniation / nerve root compression — angle is key diagnostic discriminator

ASSESS_011.name: Slump Test
ASSESS_011.diagnostic_value: Neural tension — confirms nerve root involvement alongside SLR

ASSESS_012.name: Spurling's Test

key_metric.label: Radiates to
key_metric.diagnostic_reason: Distribution pattern identifies nerve root level

ASSESS_012.diagnostic_value: Cervical radiculopathy — distribution identifies nerve root

ASSESS_013.name: FABER Test (Patrick's)
ASSESS_013.diagnostic_value: Differentiates hip joint vs SI joint pathology — result tells you which

ASSESS_014.name: FADIR Test
ASSESS_014.diagnostic_value: Hip impingement / labral tear — clicking suggests labral pathology

ASSESS_015.name: Thomas Test

key_metric.label: Knee
key_metric.diagnostic_reason: Knee extension implicates rec fem tightness vs iliopsoas

ASSESS_015.diagnostic_value: Hip flexor tightness — differentiates iliopsoas vs rectus femoris

ASSESS_017.name: Tinel's Sign (Carpal Tunnel)
ASSESS_017.diagnostic_value: Carpal tunnel syndrome — median nerve irritability

ASSESS_018.name: Phalen's Test

key_metric.label: Onset time
key_metric.diagnostic_reason: <30 seconds = high specificity for carpal tunnel

ASSESS_018.diagnostic_value: Carpal tunnel syndrome — faster onset = more severe compression

ASSESS_020.name: Thompson Test
ASSESS_020.diagnostic_value: Achilles tendon rupture — positive = no plantarflexion on squeeze

ASSESS_021.name: Anterior Drawer Test (Ankle)
ASSESS_021.diagnostic_value: ATFL integrity — grade indicates ligament damage severity

ASSESS_022.name: Babinski Sign
ASSESS_022.diagnostic_value: Upper motor neuron lesion — positive = UMN pathology

ASSESS_024.name: Dermatome Testing
ASSESS_024.diagnostic_value: Nerve root level identification — pattern of loss identifies root

ASSESS_025.name: Myotome Testing
ASSESS_025.diagnostic_value: Nerve root motor level — weakness pattern identifies root

ASSESS_026.name: Deep Tendon Reflexes
ASSESS_026.diagnostic_value: Nerve root level + UMN vs LMN — diminished = LMN, increased = UMN

ASSESS_028.name: Dix-Hallpike Test
ASSESS_028.diagnostic_value: BPPV — positive with nystagmus confirms posterior canal BPPV

ASSESS_030.name: SI Joint Compression Test
ASSESS_030.diagnostic_value: SI joint dysfunction — part of SI joint cluster testing

ASSESS_031.name: Gaenslen's Test
ASSESS_031.diagnostic_value: SI joint dysfunction — stresses SI joint in extension

ASSESS_032.name: Trendelenburg Test
ASSESS_032.diagnostic_value: Gluteus medius weakness / hip abductor insufficiency

key_metric.label: Painful angle
key_metric.diagnostic_reason: ~30° is classic for ITB friction syndrome

ASSESS_037.name: Varus/Valgus Stress Test
ASSESS_037.diagnostic_value: Collateral ligament integrity — direction identifies MCL vs LCL

ASSESS_038.name: Ottawa Ankle Rules

key_metric.label: Weight bearing
key_metric.diagnostic_reason: Inability to bear weight = x-ray criteria met

ASSESS_038.diagnostic_value: Fracture screening — rules out need for imaging

ASSESS_039.name: Canadian C-Spine Rules
ASSESS_039.diagnostic_value: Cervical fracture screening — clears or indicates imaging

ASSESS_042.name: Froment's Sign
ASSESS_042.diagnostic_value: Ulnar nerve palsy — adductor pollicis weakness

ASSESS_043.name: Allen's Test

key_metric.label: Artery
key_metric.diagnostic_reason: Identifies which artery has compromised flow

ASSESS_043.diagnostic_value: Vascular patency — radial vs ulnar artery compromise

ASSESS_044.name: Prone Instability Test
ASSESS_044.diagnostic_value: Lumbar segmental instability — guides stabilization exercise approach

ASSESS_046.name: Quadrant Test (Kemp's)
ASSESS_046.diagnostic_value: Facet joint pathology — local = facet, radiating = foraminal stenosis

ASSESS_050.name: Rib Spring Test
ASSESS_050.diagnostic_value: Rib mobility restriction — guides mobilization level

ASSESS_051.name: Breathing Pattern Assessment
ASSESS_051.diagnostic_value: Breathing dysfunction — apical/paradoxical = motor control issue

ASSESS_052.name: TMJ Compression Test
ASSESS_052.diagnostic_value: TMJ disc pathology — pain on compression = disc/joint surface issue

ASSESS_053.name: TMJ Lateral Deviation Test
ASSESS_053.voice_template: TMJ opening {opening}mm lateral right {lat_r}mm left {lat_l}mm deviation {deviation}
ASSESS_053.diagnostic_value: TMJ movement dysfunction — deviation pattern identifies disc displacement side

ASSESS_054.name: Scapular Assistance Test
ASSESS_054.diagnostic_value: Scapular dyskinesis — positive = scapular stabilization will help

ASSESS_055.name: Scour Test (Hip)
ASSESS_055.diagnostic_value: Intra-articular hip pathology — labral tear, OA, loose body

ASSESS_056.name: Range of Motion Assessment
ASSESS_056.diagnostic_value: Movement limitation pattern — capsular vs non-capsular pattern identifies pathology type
